📖 How to use

  1. Pick Learn to flip through flashcards of all 26 letters.

  3. Try Spell mode: enter any word to see its NATO spelling.
  4. Track your score and retry the letters you miss.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is it Alfa or Alpha?

This trainer uses the official ITU/NATO spellings: Alfa, Juliett and X-ray — the spellings designed to avoid mispronunciation over radio.

Who uses the NATO phonetic alphabet?

Yes — pilots, air-traffic control, military radio operators and emergency services use it worldwide to spell names and call signs clearly.

Is my quiz score saved anywhere?

Your score is kept only in this browser tab while you practice. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
